description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'BaseDao' that provides common data access object (DAO) functionalities such as counting, sorting, and pagination for database queries within the OrangeHRM system. It uses Doctrine ORM's QueryBuilder and involves a trait for EntityManager helper methods.

classes.name: BaseDao
classes.description: An abstract data access object class providing basic query utilities such as counting, sorting, and pagination for derived DAO classes.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the count of records by executing the paginator's count method.

methods.name: setSortingParams
methods.description: Adds sorting to the QueryBuilder if a sort field is specified in FilterParams.

methods.name: setPaginationParams
methods.description: Applies pagination limits to the QueryBuilder based on FilterParams; skips pagination if limit is zero.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Combines sorting and pagination settings on the QueryBuilder.
